previous.review_surface: Original returned pixels actually inspected through white and black alpha composites; raw file retained unchanged.
previous.observation: Actually viewed new unchanged raw, full white/black QA and both coil3x against original source/R0. Complete reviewed hollow-curl topology reference replaced isolated first-turn/closed AI bitmap, while original-only source retained closed lids, tiny neutral closed mouth, upright quiet lowered-arm pose, relaxed visible image-right hand, maid costume and full visible calves/shoes. Exactly two red beads attach at anatomical-left/image-right below bob; three visible openings genuinely switch white/black. Broad opaque gray front and narrower return remain continuous with mint pigment stripe and natural taper, no filled end-caps or previous tan/gray slot fragments on normal QA. No bright green raw transparent RGB becomes visible pigment on white/black. Compact downward resting projection is retained; this full visible coil is somewhat more outward/readable than low-resolution R0 and requires later actual adjacent-motion checks. Hat attached with two black leaves, warm peach skin and face/neck/collar/shoulder joins are coherent. Current static candidate pending fresh Sol review; no universal fixed turn-count/direction template, photography, dynamic or user acceptance.
